description:
ExoFuture is a place where I showcase my project based on the challenge "Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars." 

Even though I may not be heavily skilled yet, I have a dream of winning.

Through this event, I am hoping to acquire and develop my skills as a high schooler. This challenge appealed to me most because of how captivating it sounds and how it can facilitate astronauts in the future.
